svg.title: Chunked prefill in SGLang
svg.desc: 4 · Last chunk: D joins running_batch and starts decode
svg.text: 4 · Last chunk: D joins running_batch and starts decode
request D has a 10-token prompt · chunked_prefill_size 4 in this example
REQ_TO_TOKEN: KV SLOT OF EACH POSITION · THE ROW STAYS WITH D BETWEEN CHUNKS
After t8–t9 the prompt is done: D moves to running_batch and decodes like any request.
t8–t9 enter the tree when D finishes · the last token is computed again by the next turn.
